title: FI
tagline: Welcome to Finance! Report errors, earn rewards 💰, drive digital innovation.
description:
Welcome to Finance Incentivized! This platform revolutionizes error reporting by providing users with an intuitive interface to report errors and bugs in partner platforms. Users receive rewards in tokens for their contributions, driving digital innovation.

## Go-to-Market Strategy

- **Community Engagement:** Engage bug-hunting communities for active participation.
- **Strategic Partnerships:** Collaborate with platform owners and tech communities.
- **Education and Awareness:** Create content educating companies about bug bounty benefits.
- **Targeted Campaigns:** Tailored marketing campaigns for specific market segments.
how_its_made: Frontend built using React.js, HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Node.js and for smart contracts used Solidity. All contracts are deployed on Arbitrum. Filecoin for handling the images and Plan to make it cross-chain to enable wider adoption of market. The idea is unique and solves a genuine problem.
